Description: authority is the address of the governance account.

params defines the exchange parameters to update. Callers should supply a full Params object. Some parameter groups still preserve omitted fields, but cross_margin_params is treated as a full replacement. Sparse/raw payloads must include the full intended cross_margin_params payload because decoded false/zero/empty values are applied literally when they pass validation, including valid explicit zeros such as backstop_margin_ratio = 0.
